```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(broom)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
newgapminder <- read_csv("newgapminder.csv")
```

```{r}
newgapminder %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, lifeExp, group = country, colour = continent)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1/3) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
